title: Clockwise Circular Visits
statement: Given n and a sequence of 1-indexed targets on a numbered circle, starting at 1, output total clockwise steps needed to visit targets in order.

title: Binary Search Last Element
statement: Given sorted n integers and target x, print zero-based index if present, else -1.
bugs: Loop uses l<r instead of l<=r

title: Shortest Reach in Unweighted Graph
statement: Given undirected n-vertex m-edge graph and source s (1-indexed), output shortest edge distances to each vertex, -1 for unreachable.
bugs: Neighbor distance must be parent distance plus one

title: Grid Paths with Obstacles
statement: Count paths from top-left to bottom-right moving only right/down through 0 cells; 1 means blocked. Return result mod 1e9+7.
bugs: Start cell must be zero ways when blocked

title: Count Equal Pairs
statement: Print number of pairs i<j with a[i]==a[j], n up to 200000.
bugs: Pair count can exceed signed 32-bit range on large inputs

title: Longest Common Subsequence
statement: Given two strings, output length of their longest common subsequence.
bugs: LCS recurrence on mismatch needs max rather than min

title: Queue Processing
statement: Process integer sequence: enqueue positive x, dequeue for zero if nonempty; after all operations output remaining queue front-to-back or EMPTY.
bugs: Negative numbers should not cause dequeue; output formatting also normalized

title: Shortest Subarray with Sum at Least K
statement: For n positive integers, return minimum length of a contiguous subarray with sum >= k, or zero if none.
bugs: Boundary should include equal sum (>= instead of >)
